title: stephanomeria exigua subsp. carotifera
intro: Stephanomeria exigua subsp. carotifera, commonly known as the Thread-leaf Wormwood or Desert Wormwood, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents of Stephanomeria exigua subsp. carotifera include flavonoids, saponins, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
